Sometime between [[3973 BBY]] and [[3965 BBY]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the conflict known as the [[Mandalorian Wars]]<ref name="Date" /> between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]], a '''battle''' was fought in [[3963 BBY]] in the [[Jaminere system/Legends|Jaminere]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. Occurring after the Mandalorians [[First battle of the Lianna system|conquered]] the [[Lianna system/Legends|Lianna system]] then split their forces between their [[Battle of the Makem system (Mandalorian Wars)|attack]] on the [[Makem system]] and another against Jaminere, the battle in the Jaminere system ended in a Galactic Republic defeat. Following the engagement, the Mandalorians [[Battle of the Sy Myrth system|raided]] the [[Sy Myrth system/Legends|Sy Myrth system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the Jaminere system was referenced in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
